summary: Revert the dummy-draft block-table change (#885): startup crashed with FlashInfer autotune
compatibility: No user action required. Beta 3e670ca5 could fail at startup with a CUDA device-side assert when FlashInfer autotune is on (DS4 profiles by default, GLM TP3).
details: #885 marked every row of a dummy draft batch as padding. Warmup dummy runs then passed -1 indices to the GLM-5.3 pooled indexer, which index_select rejects.
The data-parallel fix it carried will return once the consumers handle padded rows.
